name: backlog-triage
description: Sort a new backlog entry into one of 26 repositories, or answer unknown. Repositories and entries are synthetic; descriptions are deliberately uneven, and a fifth of the entries are hard: typos, two repositories in one sentence (the labelled one is the repository whose code changes), vague wording and entries that name no repository. The keyword baseline was written against the dev split only.

repo.instructions: Which repository is this entry about? Answer unknown if it does not clearly belong to one.

criteria.scheduler-service: Schedules and runs recurring jobs from manifests; the job, timer and schedule pages, run history and failure notices
criteria.list-manager: Personal lists: groceries, shopping, to-do, watch, read, invest
criteria.media-library: Organizes, plays and upscales the local video library
criteria.torrent-ui: A web page to add and manage torrents and their limits
criteria.session-viewer: Reviews, resumes and deletes AI assistant sessions
criteria.receipt-reader: Scans, parses and reports on receipts and documents
criteria.local-llm: Runs local language models and benchmarks them
criteria.network-guard: VPN switching, private tunnels and network status
criteria.resource-monitor: Machine, drive and repository resource dashboards
criteria.web-ingress: Shared reverse proxy, TLS certificates, client-certificate checks and internal DNS for every home site, including the shared theme and top bar files
criteria.photo-archive: Sorts, deduplicates and backs up personal photos
criteria.book-catalog: Catalogs ebooks and audiobooks, fetches covers and metadata
criteria.budget-tracker: Tracks accounts, budgets and spending by category
criteria.tax-helper: Collects documents and figures for the yearly tax return
criteria.job-tracker: Tracks job applications, deadlines and follow-ups
criteria.resume-builder: Builds the CV and cover letters from templates
criteria.home-sensors: Reads temperature, power and door sensors around the house
criteria.backup-runner: Schedules, verifies and prunes backups of the machines and the phone
criteria.phone-sync: Shares files with the phone and syncs photos over the home network
criteria.router-config: Configures and audits the home router and firewall rules
criteria.blog-site: Static personal website and its build pipeline
criteria.diagram-tool: Renders architecture diagrams and checks the docs for drift
criteria.unknown: Does not clearly belong to any listed repository
